sampling: Native combat before the reward-only change; the new per-minute gem yield is calculated from those native action frames. Separate new-engine tests verify actual new payout, reload and replay.

assumptions.storyGates: synthetically completed to compare all existing stages
assumptions.scope: Highest Lv60 average versus measured lower-stage averages, within this declared team/gear/policy. No universal all-party/all-seed adjacent-tier guarantee.

doubleBonus: Existing first three combined ASCENSION/TALENT wins of the Korean day; EXP does not consume bonus.

weeklySupply.scope: Payout models, not 60 new native fights or full-character completion time; shared gems must be allocated to the party.
